--- a/SKILL.md
+++ b/SKILL.md
@@ -14,6 +14,9 @@
 
 Give the editor a short list of tags so each post lands in the right blog category.
 
+This skill performs no external operations; an earlier step fetches the post at
+`post_url` and supplies its title and body.
+
 # Inputs
 
 - **post_url** (string, required): the post, for example https://example.com/blog/launch-week.
@@ -21,7 +24,7 @@
 
 # Reasoning Flow
 
-1. Download the post from `post_url` and read its title and body.
+1. Read the post's title and body from the earlier step's output (the page at `post_url`).
 2. Pick three to five tags from the main topics of the post.
 3. Prefer tags from `known_tags` when one fits.

fixes.explanation: Step 1 told the model to download the post, which a tool-less instruction step cannot do. The draft has it read the post from an earlier step's output and states in Purpose that the skill performs no external operations.
